FAQ — IT Helpdesk

Q: How do I reset my password?
A: Use the self-service portal at reset.alderbrooksystems.example, or contact
   it-helpdesk@alderbrooksystems.example if locked out.

Q: My VPN won't connect, what do I do?
A: Confirm you're on the latest VPN client version (check the #it-helpdesk pinned post), then
   restart the client. If it persists, file a ticket with the error code shown.

Q: How do I request new software?
A: Submit a request via the IT Service Catalog; approval SLA is 2 business days for standard
   software, longer for anything requiring security review.

Q: What do I do if my laptop is lost or stolen?
A: Report immediately to it-helpdesk@alderbrooksystems.example so it can be remotely wiped; also
   file a report with your manager within 24 hours.
